subject: ddl: improve FLASHBACK DATABASE for many table case (#54439)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on FLASHBACK DATABASE (recover schema/table) DDL flow and infoschema/schema-diff behavior. Change safely avoids persisting huge RecoverTabsInfo by adding RecoverSchemaInfo.LoadTablesOnExecute and reconstructing table list on the DDL owner from snapshot meta; schema recovery still performs safe-point checks, disables TTL on recovered tables, and recovers each table via the existing recoverTable path. Passing per-table IDs via updateSchemaVersion(..., diffInfos...) ensures SchemaDiff.AffectedOpts covers all recovered tables even when RecoverTabsInfo is empty, preserving infoschema incremental update correctness. Placement clearing is centralized in recoverTable (with context propagation) and Domain.GetSnapshotMeta signature simplification removes a previously-always-nil error return. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata/state handling for the touched DDL paths.
